verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI inference cloud, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no scheduler, cron, or recurring workflow feature. The flex tier for 'asynchronous workloads' is a per-request pricing tier, not a recurring schedule. SSH access to rented GPU clusters would leave scheduling as a user-side workaround, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
